searchText: Sure can, <@240180844130598912> . Here's a PR: https://github.com/eth-clients/e2store-format-specs/pull/11 Awesome, thank you very much 🙏 Hey <@194432762315407360> , should we expect STEEL or EELS to implement some tests for eth/69? would not like to merge the PR before then CC, <@892053833121923094> you mean, would not like to merge the implementation in Nethermind before then? I will finish the updates for the eth protocol testing tool today. It's the thing that runs the devp2p "eth" tests on hive. We'll have some tests for the receipts there, and some for BlockRangeUpdate But the BlockRangeUpdate can't be fully tested anyway, since it relies on history expiry the only thing I can test is that the client does not reject the test peer when it announces incomplete history Thank you very much, let me know if you need anything from our side. Would love to help. eth/69 now merged in geth if you run hive now, it should use the new tests ``` ./hive --sim devp2p --sim.limit eth --docker.nocache devp2p --client-file clients.yaml ```
